# device42_power_circuit (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_power_circuit" "myNewPowerCircuit" {
   breakerpanel_id = "12"
   number          = "4"
   label           = "Server rack A"
   amps            = 20
   voltage         = 230
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `breakerpanel_id` (String) Identifier of the breaker panel this circuit is attached to. Create only.
- `number` (String) Number of the circuit within the breaker panel. Create only.

### Optional

- `amps` (Number) Amperage rating of the circuit.
- `connection_name` (String) Name of the power connection type.
- `label` (String) Label of the power circuit.
- `voltage` (Number) Voltage rating of the circuit.

### Read-Only

- `breakerpanel` (String) Name of the breaker panel.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
